properties.notes: The Council's Development Management Committee resolved to grant planning permission in June 2020 for the demolition of the existing buildings and the construction of 100 residential units, as well as 128 student units and flexible retail/commercial/business/community floorspace, subject to the completion of a satisfactory s106 legal agreement (ref. 20/00171/FULPP)
